title: 第6章【冥婚】张破烂
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这个张晓顾原是有点印象的，在房间的时候他坐在自己的正对面，只是没想到在剧本杀中的角色竟然是这么一个穿着破烂的人。

“我是张晓，你可以叫我张破烂。”张晓说道。

顾原一愣，脸上露出迟疑的表情，心想这张破烂是个什么名字？

张晓微微一笑，“张破烂只是一个外号而已，不需要这么计较这些。”

“我来这里，是因为这个地方出现了不应该出现的东西，相比那些东西你应该已经接触过了。”张晓接着说道。

顾原心中大致已经有了判断，毕竟这里不应该出现的东西只有一个，那就是那些尸体。

“你怎么知道这里不对？”

“那是因为我打听到我之前的师哥他在这里，一旦只要他出现在哪里，那里就会有事发生。”

从张晓的口中他已经可以判断出来，那个师哥就是马家请的高人，顾原眼睛一凉，“既然你们是出同门，那是不是你能对付他？”

张晓会心一笑，随后表情一变，“不行，我不是他的对手，要不然怎么人家是师哥呢。”

“既然如此，那你来这里干什么？”

“当然是来解决那些东西的。”张晓白了一眼顾原，接着道：“虽然我不是师哥的对手，但是我也不能看着他祸害别人，所以该做的事还是要做的。”

顾原点点头将人请了进来，现在他有了一个帮手，想来去抢回方清的尸体应该会简单一些。

没过多久，男人带着医生回来，医生检查了十多分钟随后说没什么大事，开了点药休息一段时间就好。

接着，张晓拉着顾原问什么时候行动，顾原看了看时间，道：“一会就去，我相信他们绝对猜不到刚才逃走的两人竟然还敢杀一个回马枪。”

张晓点点头，挠了挠他那满头灰的头发，笑着说道：“既然你决定了，那我去准备东西，给我几分钟。”

说完，张晓便离开了，而顾原则在房间内等了几分钟，没一会张晓便回来了，不同的是他的手中多了一个挎包，见到顾原的瞬间，张晓从包中掏出来一把铜钱剑扔给了顾原。

“这个能对那些尸体造成伤害，别搞坏了。”

顾原手中拿着铜钱剑掂量了几下，并不重，并且传来了一股冰冷的感觉，像是在冰窖里保存的一样。

“那你用什么？”

This Zhang Xiaogu had some impression of him. He was sitting directly opposite him in the room, but he didn't expect that the character in the script would be such a shabby person.

"I am Zhang Xiao, you can call me Zhang Polan." Zhang Xiao said.

Gu Yuan was stunned for a moment, with a hesitant expression on his face, wondering what the name of this piece of tatters was?

Zhang Xiao smiled slightly, "Zhang Polan is just a nickname, there is no need to care about it so much."

"I came here because there are things that should not appear in this place. You should have been exposed to those things before." Zhang Xiao continued.

Gu Yuan has already made a general judgment in his mind. After all, there is only one thing that should not appear here, and that is those corpses.

"How do you know something is wrong here?"

"That's because I found out that my former senior brother is here. Whenever he appears somewhere, something will happen there."

He could already tell from Zhang Xiao's words that the senior brother was an expert hired by the Ma family. Gu Yuan's eyes turned cold, "Since you are from the same sect, can you deal with him?"

Zhang Xiao smiled knowingly, and then his expression changed, "No, I am not his opponent, otherwise why would he be a senior brother?"

"In that case, what are you doing here?"

"Of course I'm here to deal with those things." Zhang Xiao rolled his eyes at Gu Yuan and continued: "Although I am not Senior Brother's opponent, I can't watch him harm others, so I still have to do what needs to be done."

Gu Yuan nodded and invited the people in. Now that he had a helper, it would be easier to snatch back Fang Qing's body.

Not long after, the man came back with a doctor. The doctor examined him for more than ten minutes and then said it was nothing serious. He just prescribed some medicine and rested for a while.

Then, Zhang Xiao pulled Gu Yuan and asked when he would take action. Gu Yuan looked at the time and said, "We will go in a moment. I believe they would never guess that the two people who escaped just now dared to kill one of them."

Zhang Xiao nodded, scratched his gray hair, and said with a smile: "Since you have decided, then I will prepare things, give me a few minutes."

After saying that, Zhang Xiao left, while Gu Principle waited in the room for a few minutes. After a while, Zhang Xiao came back. The difference was that he had an extra satchel in his hand. The moment he saw Gu Yuan, Zhang Xiao took out a copper coin sword from the bag and threw it to Gu Yuan.

"This can cause damage to those corpses, don't break it."

Gu Yuan held the copper coin sword in his hand and weighed it a few times. It was not heavy, and he felt a cold feeling, as if it had been preserved in an ice cellar.

"Then what do you use?"
